rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 3-3.2, Tables 2-3 - authors fabricated the solar-powered drip applicator and measured dripper/sprinkler discharge, solar insolation and panel/battery voltage during testing at CCSHAU Hisar. Q2: Abstract and Section 3.2 - average dripper discharge 79.9 ml/min, sprinkler 640.2 ml/min, average insolation about 948 W/m2; the machine with drip was evaluated in bottle gourd and performance stated as satisfactory to save the crop under dry spell conditions. Q9: Table 2 reports discharge as mean <U+00B1> SD (79.9 <U+00B1> 6.85 and 640.2 <U+00B1> 18.33 ml/min); Table 3 reports insolation 947.86 <U+00B1> 124.3 W/m2.
rows.notes: The discharge and insolation figures in the passage are the study's own measurements, but the 'crop rescue under severe moisture stress' part rests only on a one-line qualitative statement that performance in bottle gourd was 'satisfactory'; no crop survival, yield, soil moisture or control data are reported. Single site, single crop, single week of testing; no intermediate variable measured; no limitations stated; the underlying numbers are attributed to a commercial test report (ref 10) from the authors' own testing centre.
